subject.title: feat: 0.5.0 API surface — archive policy, publication mechanics, sync locks, secret create-only, Root.walk, cleanup receipts

question: Should this release introduce the full archive, publication, lock, secret, walk, and cleanup API set as one v0.5.0 public contract, or should the scope be narrowed into separately reviewed features?
rationale: The branch creates many new exported policy knobs and compatibility commitments; resolving the archive permission defect does not determine whether this combined public surface is the intended package direction.

options.title: Approve a narrowed, security-hardened v0.5.0 scope
options.body: Keep only the APIs with confirmed adoption needs, repair the archive default, and complete platform and runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Split the API families
options.body: Move independent archive, locking, and publication additions into focused PRs so each public contract can receive its own compatibility review.

options.title: Defer the release surface
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers publish a narrower release plan and compatibility expectations for the new APIs.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrowed, security-hardened v0.5.0 scope
recommendation.body: Keep only the APIs with confirmed adoption needs, repair the archive default, and complete platform and runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: ctbritt is the only concrete current-main contributor identified in the supplied related history for behavior this branch extends; broader API ownership remains ambiguous.
